notes: The page names 00267E10, 0026B4E0, 00280120, 002650B0 and 002640C0; every other callee is cited by site (a tail jump by the jmp's offset). 00280120 takes no argument (it reads 0209AC30's object, per the page), so after it rdx, r8 and r9 are still the incoming registers; where a body sets no argument for its next call I say so instead of guessing. On the guard's non-zero path the void-style bodies return with 00280120's result still in eax. 00510F30 and 00511010 save rbx/rsi/rdi/r14 only on the work path. Doubts: none on reading; 00511010's stored order (word 0 to the fourth resolved pointer) is the point to check.
